title: ChemExplain: A Multimodal Benchmark for Explanatory Chemical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.17183v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current chemistry benchmarks primarily evaluate outcome prediction or reaction pathway generation, but rarely test whether a model can explain why an observed chemical effect occurs. We introduce ChemExplain, a benchmark of 1,180 multiple-choice chemistry questions drawn from 383 peer-reviewed papers. Each question pairs a molecular or reaction image with an observed chemical effect and four candidate explanations, each associated with a different structural feature visible in the image. Answering requires the model to perceive the depicted structure, apply chemical knowledge, and identify which feature most directly explains the effect, a capability we term explanatory attribution. The correct feature-mechanism relation is derived from supporting evidence in the source paper rather than invented by the question-generation LLM. We construct the benchmark automatically with a multi-agent framework that applies progressive quality control

translated_title: ChemExplain：一个用于解释性化学推理的多模态基准测试
translated_abstract: 当前化学基准测试主要评估结果预测或反应路径生成，但很少测试模型能否解释为什么会出现某种观察到的化学效应。我们提出了ChemExplain，这是一个包含1,180道化学多选题的基准测试，题目来源于383篇同行评审论文。每个问题将分子或反应图像与一个观察到的化学效应以及四个候选解释配对，每个候选解释都与图像中可见的不同结构特征相关联。回答问题需要模型感知所描绘的结构、应用化学知识，并识别哪个特征最直接地解释了该效应，我们将这种能力称为解释性归因。正确的特征-机制关系源自源论文中的支持证据，而非由生成问题的LLM凭空编造。我们使用应用渐进式质量控制的多智能体框架自动构建了该基准测试。
tldr: ChemExplain是一个包含1,180道源自383篇论文的化学多选题基准测试，通过要求模型识别图像中最能解释观察到的化学效应的结构特征，评估多模态模型的解释性归因能力。
en_tdlr: ChemExplain is a benchmark of 1,180 chemistry multiple-choice questions drawn from 383 papers that evaluates multimodal models' explanatory attribution capability—identifying which structural feature visible in an image most directly explains an observed chemical effect.
